statutory_framework: State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) & National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) Norms
administered_by: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Ministry of Agriculture & State Revenue / Disaster Management Departments
calamity_eligibility_threshold: Crop loss of 33% and above caused by notified natural calamities (Hailstorm, Unseasonal Heavy Rains, Flooding, Cyclone, Drought, Pest Outbreak deemed natural calamity)

input_subsidy_compensation_rates.category: Rainfed / Unirrigated Crops (e.g. Dryland Pulses, Millets, Rainfed Cotton)
input_subsidy_compensation_rates.max_limit: Subject to ceiling of 2 hectares (5 acres) per farmer

input_subsidy_compensation_rates.category: Irrigated Crops (e.g. Paddy, Irrigated Cotton, Maize, Chilli)
input_subsidy_compensation_rates.max_limit: Subject to ceiling of 2 hectares (5 acres) per farmer

input_subsidy_compensation_rates.category: Perennial Horticulture Crops (e.g. Mango, Citrus, Guava, Oil Palm)
input_subsidy_compensation_rates.max_limit: Subject to ceiling of 2 hectares (5 acres) per farmer

input_subsidy_compensation_rates.category: Desiltation of Agricultural Land (Silt deposition > 3 inches after flash floods)
input_subsidy_compensation_rates.max_limit: Eligible for small and marginal farmers
input_subsidy_compensation_rates.loss_criteria: Sand/silt deposition > 3 inches rendering field uncultivable

telangana_special_ex_gratia.scheme_name: Telangana Calamity Relief Assistance (Rythu Runa & Crop Relief)
telangana_special_ex_gratia.rate_per_acre: ₹10,000 per acre for damaged standing crops during declared unseasonal hailstorms/floods
telangana_special_ex_gratia.verification_team: Joint inspection team of Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) and Village Revenue Officer (VRO)

claim_enumeration_procedure: Step 1: Joint Field Enumeration (Azmoish) by Revenue Inspector / VRO and Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) within 7 days of calamity event
Step 2: Geo-tagged photo documentation with survey numbers and GPS coordinates
Step 3: Preparation of draft beneficiary list displayed at Gram Panchayat / Rythu Vedika for 48 hours for public verification & objection filing
Step 4: Approval by District Collector / District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA)
Step 5: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into farmer's Aadhaar-seeded bank account
critical_difference_pmfby_vs_sdrf: SDRF/NDRF is non-insurance sovereign disaster relief ex-gratia provided by the Government regardless of whether the crop was insured under PMFBY. A farmer can receive SDRF input subsidy in addition to statutory PMFBY insurance payouts.
official_sources: Ministry of Home Affairs SDRF/NDRF Revised Norms 2023-2026
Disaster Management Division, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
